sermon.title: The Jezebel Syndrome
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer calls believers to love God with understanding and return to their first love. From Jezebel and Ahab—killing the prophets, Baal worship, Naboth’s vineyard—and the seven thousand who did not bow, he defines the Jezebel syndrome as silencing and harming those outside one’s circle. He applies Jesus’ warning to Thyatira to false teaching in the church and urges believers to rise with the word.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “the Supreme Court has declared atheism a religion” (a federal appeals ruling, not the Supreme Court); “850 false prophets” killed by the people (1 Kings 18:40 names Baal’s prophets, at Elijah’s command); Naboth’s widow and the tattooed witnesses are his own embellishment; 2 Kings 9:5 wording. Unverified figures as spoken: over 75% don’t attend church; 600,000+ children molested yearly; over 50% of Americans with an STD. Sensitive content kept as spoken: Christians taking up arms and using the military (28:00–29:30); graphic description of militant mutilation (30:17); Muslims enslaving infidels; homosexuals facing the lake of fire and AIDS death (51:50); Catholic pilgrims crawling; CNN/MSNBC, Obama; dispensationalism called “idiotic.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify to you these things in the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”
And so we have the prophetic word confirmed, which you do well to heed as a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts;
knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of any private interpretation, for prophecy never came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

faqs.question: Can you love God without understanding?
faqs.answer: No—you have to understand how to love him.

faqs.question: Should we just wait for the rapture?
faqs.answer: He says most likely not for quite some time; your family will be hurt waiting.

faqs.question: What is the first love in Revelation 2:4?
faqs.answer: The love of God, not the harvest field.

faqs.question: Did God create people sinful?
faqs.answer: No—he created man good; we deviated.

faqs.question: What is a religionist?
faqs.answer: Someone who creates their own god and principles to serve it.

faqs.question: Who defeated the Syrian invaders?
faqs.answer: The seven thousand who had not bowed to Baal.

faqs.question: Should witnesses be examined?
faqs.answer: Yes—the Bible says witnesses must be examined.

faqs.question: Is Jezebel in Revelation literally a woman?
faqs.answer: He says it is false teachers likened to Jezebel.
